items.title:
com.withorb.api:orb-java 1.38.0 发布, Orb's API is built with the following principles in mind:

1. **Predictable developer experience**: Where applicable, the Orb API uses
   industry-standard patterns such as cursor-based pagination and standardized
   error output. To help with debugging in critical API actions, the API always
   strives to provide detailed and actionable error messages. Aliases such as
   external customer IDs aid in fast integration times.
2. **Reliably real time**: Orb's event-based APIs, such as event ingestion are
   designed to handle extremely high throughput and scale with concurrent load.
   Orb also provides a real-time event-level credits ledger and a highly
   performant webhooks architecture.
3. **Flexibility at the forefront**: Features like timezone localization and the
   ability to amend historical usage show the flexible nature of the platform.

You can download the latest OpenAPI spec
[here](https://api.withorb.com/spec.json) - pass `?version=3.0` for an OpenAPI
3.0-compatible spec.

org.alexmond:sba-extension-store-redis 4.1.1.1 发布, Resilient Redis-backed InstanceEventStore for Spring Boot Admin. The in-memory log
        is authoritative (extends SBA's InMemoryEventStore); Redis is a fully reactive (Lettuce, no
        blocking calls) write-behind mirror for durability. A Redis outage never blanks the registry
        (reads stay in-memory) and never fails a write — it's surfaced as a non-fatal DEGRADED health
        status instead. Hydrates from Redis on startup. Connection uses the standard spring.data.redis.*
        config. Opt-in via sba.eventstore.type=redis.

items.title:
org.alexmond:sba-extension-live-metrics 4.1.1.1 发布, SBA custom UI: a "Live Metrics" page — replicates the standard Metrics view but
        renders each selected metric as a live, rolling time-series line chart (like the CPU/Memory
        graphs on the Overview page) instead of a one-shot value. The user picks an instance + metric
        (+ optional tag filters) and adds a graph; graphs poll the instance's actuator on an interval,
        can be removed, and persist across reloads via localStorage. Built with Vite/Vue and shipped
        as a resources jar under META-INF/spring-boot-admin-server-ui/extensions/live-metrics.
